announcements.title: Project Submission!
announcements.content:
Dear Students,
The Project Submission folder on FOL is now open.
Please follow the instructions below when submitting your work:
Save your notebook and ensure that all cell outputs are visible.
Export your notebook as a PDF file.
Submit both:
The PDF file, and
A complete, runnable version of your project code (Jupyter Notebook or Colab Notebook).
Upload both files to the Project Submission Folder on FOL.
Important:The firm due date for the project is: December 7, 2025 at 11:59 PM
This project contributes 40% to your overall course grade:
30% for the project notebook submission
10% for the project presentation
If you have any questions, please feel free to ask.
Regards,
Sulaiman.
